comments.value: Having to fiddle with the camera for ages to do this is really annoying, we should be able to upload custom pictures instead

I completely agree with this, cause if I want a nice preview image I often have to prepare a pic AHEAD of time, put it on a quad, move it around endlessly, and then FINALLY upload. Hell, I've had this take longer than the avatar itself in cases of simple avatars before.

@{5a95256f54d514123c1f089d|full_name}: You could simply upload an obj file that is a texture slapped onto a mesh, then upload the avatar with the image, then upload it again, without the image, but leaving the image to the previous version.
Not efficient but it works.
I believe you can also modify the image of the previous avatar upload where it is stored in the sdk, which also works.

@{5dc5b9b25689666d718db510|full_name}: It is possible to use custom images with little tricks. You don't even need to remove the mesh as if it's not part of the avatar it won't get uploaded with it, I'm just saying it could be a bit easier than that.

Yes please! Having to re-upload an avatar just to update a thumbnail is a pain.

PRO TIP:
If you copy the VRCCam then place it in your scene it will override the VRCCam created during upload. Place it at 0,0,0 inside an empty game object. Then you can move that game object around and fiddle with the cam settings to your hearts content before uploading.

When you upload, just delete the new VRCCam and reset the Transform of your VRCCam. Now you have the perfect thumbnail
They should also add support for .gif pfp's aswell.
@{5d34d4468414474f8dad41b0|full_name}: I don't think that would work well for thumbnails and pedestals, though

details: Can we get some kind of functionality that can let us upload a JPG or PNG for avatar profile pictures?
title: Custom Profile Picture uploader?
